name: sum-geometric-progressions

text.en: Find the sum of the infinite series

answer: (() => { const coeff1 = new Frac(a).pow(j_a); const ratio1 = new Frac(a).pow(i_a).div(new Frac(c)); const coeff2 = new Frac(b).pow(j_b); const ratio2 = new Frac(b).pow(i_b).div(new Frac(c)); if (Math.abs(ratio1.num / ratio1.den) >= 1 || Math.abs(ratio2.num / ratio2.den) >= 1) { return null; } const sum1_num = coeff1.mul(ratio1.pow(n0)); const sum1_den = new Frac(1).sub(ratio1); const sum1 = sum1_num.div(sum1_den); const sum2_num = coeff2.mul(ratio2.pow(n0)); const sum2_den = new Frac(1).sub(ratio2); const sum2 = sum2_num.div(sum2_den); const result = pm == '+' ? sum1.add(sum2) : sum1.sub(sum2); return result.toString(); })()
